row.name: Roku Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=27 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.22 tightness=0.55 base_volume_vs_leg=0.46 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 27 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -0.3% vs its 20-SMA, -1.4% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: VOL is a hard FAIL: the base is 27 sessions long, triggering the catalyst-volume requirement, and the burst day came in at only 0.85x the 50-session average with a rank of 37 out of 60 — well below the 1.5x threshold needed for a base this long. The base itself is visually wide and declining from the ~160 peak through the shaded region, with multiple overlapping red and green bars drifting lower across the full 27-session box, which is outside Bonde's 3–20 session window. These two independent defects — a volume FAIL and a loose, overlong, declining base — together pull the grade from A+ to B.
claude.key_risk: The base is a slow drift lower from the August highs with no catalyst-level volume on the burst day, making follow-through unlikely without a genuine news event.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of 153.41 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace with no news catalyst.
